decisions.reason: Although its web prominence fell after launch, it remains close to the core upholstery range and is likely inexpensive for a medium textile firm with production partners to keep as an option while serving assortment breadth.

This decorative fabric stayed present across both years, and because it fits the firm's established offer and broad-collection strategy, the cost of keeping it appears low relative to its still-uncertain upside.

After two seasons it shows only limited visibility, and as a wool-blend niche variant it offers less strategic upside than the firm's other nearby options while also fitting less cleanly with the move away from hard-to-recycle blends.

It remains on offer and extends the firm's decorative textile language in a way that is still close to core capabilities, so the option value of keeping it likely exceeds the cost of carrying it one period longer.
